authority.newest_owner_direction: Normal hero actions hidden and outside focus until original opening completes; free retained; direct €99 + VAT quarterly standard pack; other panels later as quiet inline text. This explicitly supersedes earlier immediate-CTA and choose-panel guidance.

criteria.criterion: 1. Normal opening visibility and focus gate
criteria.evidence: Six normal EN/ES320/390/1366 cases remain pending/watching with both actions visibility:hidden, all hit points false and direct focus rejected. Tab skips from the header trigger to the first chapter control; Shift+Tab returns to the header. Navigation focus and Escape do not reveal actions or skip the opening.

criteria.criterion: 2. Existing completion callback and original motion
criteria.evidence: The actual tracked callback produces reveal/arrival-complete; normal probes never force skip. Measured first-decoded-frame→reveal intervals are 2296.8–2321.1 ms. Original runner modules and HERO_ENTRANCE_RATE remain byte-identical, video playbackRate=1, and no new reveal timer was added. Existing fail-open fallback remains distinct from normal success. Both links become focusable and hit-testable after the reveal.

criteria.criterion: 3. Reduced motion, no JavaScript and real media failure
criteria.evidence: Six reduced-motion main cases, six JavaScript-disabled cases and six real runner-request-abort cases pass. Fallback checks use real conditions rather than assigning entry state. The six focused no-JS rechecks additionally verify visible opacity chains, pointer:auto, three true hit points per action and successful paid navigation after focus is blurred.

criteria.criterion: 4. Paid meaning, bilingual copy and compact fit
criteria.evidence: Start with the pack / Empieza con el pack plus €99 + VAT / quarter / 99 € + IVA / trimestre express the requested paid meaning in two single-line roles. Accessible labels state the full pack meaning and quarterly subscription. All twelve views retain 44px controls, Hanken 600 14px label and Hanken 400 13px detail; label/detail heights are 18/16px. No third action, wrapped third line, clipped text, overlap or smaller substitute type observed.

criteria.criterion: 5. Free, direct paid intent and separate other panels
criteria.evidence: Actual free clicks retain plan=free and upload return intent. Actual paid clicks go directly to locale signup?plan=quarterly; destination visibly presents 13 biomarkers, €99 + VAT per quarter and cancel anytime. Tests stop at account forms. Later other-panels links are semantic underlined inline anchors (border0/padding0/no SVG/no button role) leading to existing enhanced/pricing details, where comparison remains available.

criteria.criterion: 6. Preserved product/medical truth, examples and EVA design
criteria.evidence: No new medical claim is introduced. ApoB remains excluded from standard and included in enhanced; unconfirmed enhanced scope/count/price/frequency/timing/availability stay qualified, and full laboratory panel remains distinct. Alex remains 2.1 with original history and a visible problem bridge. Separate range remains 2.9, strict <3 lab and <1 lower relative-risk category on the original 0–5 geometry. Existing logo PNG hash, Hanken, analog artwork and actual media are retained; affected surfaces add no AI/biological-age launch promise.

criteria.criterion: 7. Exact rendered evidence and Impeccable type/spacing
criteria.evidence: Independent source/diff review plus own inspection of 33 named visual surfaces across EN/ES desktop/mobile, including final representative rechecks after the fallback correction. Current source matches both completed reports. The final24-case report has no page errors, network writes, external reads or missing files; browsers closed. Scoped changed-target Impeccable detector JSON is []. Settled selector contrast is 15.29:1 unselected and16.83:1 selected, including after switching.

resolved_findings.finding: No-JS actions were visible but could not be clicked in all six initial fallback cases.
resolved_findings.cause: The important pointer-events:none gated selector had greater specificity than the original noscript important auto override.
resolved_findings.correction: Explicit higher-specificity noscript and reduced-motion pointer overrides for non-immediate reveal wrappers and descendants.
resolved_findings.recheck: Full24 PASS and all six after-blur no-JS cases PASS.

resolved_findings.finding: Other-panels selector screenshot initially captured intermediate background/text colors during its existing transition.
resolved_findings.correction: Evidence runner waits for the existing transition to settle and measures selected/unselected colors after switches; no pricing UI change.
resolved_findings.recheck: 15.29/16.83 ratios and updated settled screenshots pass.

resolved_findings.finding: One desktop no-JS image initially appeared to omit the actions in a grouped image view.
resolved_findings.correction: Reopened the same image individually; visible actions confirmed, with raw expected-CTA pixels and six after-blur visibility/hit rechecks.
